description: Native chat surface (ActionUIChat add-on). A transcript above a composer, driven by a transport selected by the protocol property. Landed: the local transport with a single-alignment transcript (M1), streaming Markdown and image items (M2), the agentic surfaces - thoughts, tool-call cards, permission approvals - routed by the surfaces property, and the ACP transport that hosts any Agent Client Protocol agent over stdio on macOS (M3). The SSE transports, dual alignment, and side panels arrive in later milestones.

protocol.description: Transport selector. Default local. Implemented: local, and acp on macOS (the ACP agent runs as a subprocess; transport.command is required). Others fall back to local.

alignment.description: single (default): leading/full-width. dual (later): incoming leading, outgoing trailing

showRoleLabels.description: Show a small role label above each message; default true

roles.description: Per-role styling, keyed by role (local, agent, remote, system). Each value is an object with optional label, tint, and side (side is used by dual alignment, a later milestone).

enabled.description: Whether the composer accepts input; default true

surfaces.description: Routing for agentic transport items (only transports that emit them are affected)

toolCalls.description: Tool-call cards: inline (default: expanded card), collapsed (detail folded), hidden (dropped). panel arrives with the M5 side panels and renders inline for now

thoughts.description: Streamed reasoning: collapsed (default: folded behind a disclosure), inline (expanded), hidden (dropped). panel arrives with the M5 side panels and renders inline for now

transport.description: Protocol-specific transport config, validated by the chosen transport. The local transport honors echo (boolean, default true: stream a demo reply), reply (string: echo default, markdown, or agentic - a scripted agent turn with thoughts, tool calls, and a permission gate), and chunkMs (integer: demo streaming pace, default 45). The acp transport requires command (array of strings: the agent argv, e.g. ["claude-code-acp"]) and honors cwd (string: the session root, default the host's current directory) and mcpServers (array: MCP server declarations passed to the agent verbatim).

sendActionID.description: Fired when the user submits a message

stopActionID.description: Fired when the user cancels an in-flight turn

messageActionID.description: Fired per finalized message (user and agent)

errorActionID.description: Fired on a transport / parse error

approveToolActionID.description: Fired when an agent requests permission for a tool call (the request queues an approval card in the element)
